0022600142.text: The Mavericks, who are 2-2 and 3rd in the Southwest, host the undefeated Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 4-0, lead the Northwest, and are on a four-game winning streak. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) are listed as day-to-day. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), with Alex Caruso (ankle) also day-to-day. This is the teams' first meeting of 2026-27 after the Mavericks lost 0-3 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 100-87 loss in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
